steps.path: Light and Crème themes — floating buddy and matching in-app mascots
steps.headline: Keep the character and soften its palette, or give these themes distinct characters?
steps.today: Light and Crème reuse the default rounded buddy. Its body and face borrow the theme's button colors, which can make the body dark and the eyes pale.
steps.problem: The high-contrast, inverted face reads as frightening rather than friendly. Readable button colors do not automatically make an appealing character.
steps.proposal: I recommend keeping the existing shape and expressions, using lighter theme-related body colors, dark facial features, and gentler shading. I will show before-and-after views before finalizing. Theme-builder guidance will cover friendly silhouettes, readable expressions, restrained highlights and shadows, and checks at actual mascot size while allowing different character styles.

options.label: Softer palette, same buddy
pros: Directly fixes the harsh face without replacing the character you already use.
Keeps existing expressions and movement; leaves successful community artwork alone.
cons: Light and Crème remain variations of the same character rather than distinct mascots.

options.label: Distinct themed characters
pros: Gives Light and Crème their own visual identities and more personality.
cons: A larger redesign, with new shapes and expressions to review rather than just a styling correction.
